column1: # Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Nintendo's engine on SDK 20.5.3, update 1.0.4; 14,400 shaders, all translated.
# Tested 2026-11-06 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), docked: the date check, region and currency, the island (the 3D island, its sea and

# trees, the cursor and the camera), naming the island, the Mii creation menus. 30 fps, the game's own pace (it asks present interval 1, frame work about 33 ms); 0 dropped frames; 0 audio underruns; no red log line.
# It aborted at boot until the host answered ClockSnapshot::CreateWithAdjustableSystemClock (hle_time.c).
# Open: the Mii heads draw nothing ("Which Mii do you want to start with?" shows two empty cards). The game draws them with the SDK's Mii renderer from the console's
# MiiModel system data (0100000000000802), firmware content the host does not ship: its stand-in has no textures and no shapes (hle_mii.c). A game about Miis needs the
# real files, from the player's own firmware.
